desc:
Framer site content updates and care keep your website accurate while you run the rest of your business. Ecom Swift LLC offers a fixed starter sprint: you send the updates, we make them in your Framer project, check everything and report back.

## What is a Framer management sprint?

A Framer management sprint is a one-time batch of upkeep work on your site. You send text, images, posts, pages or offers. We add them, fix what is broken, check links and forms, review each page on phone and desktop, and send a short report.

It is a trial of working together, not a subscription. Ongoing monthly care is quoted separately, once you have seen how the sprint goes.

## Why upkeep gets neglected and why it matters

Websites go stale quietly. A price changes and the old one stays online. A team member leaves but still appears on the about page. An event ends, and its banner stays. A form sends to an old address. Each item is small, yet together they tell visitors that nobody is watching.

Upkeep tasks also tend to lose out to urgent work. A batch approach solves that. Instead of fifty reminders, you collect everything in one message, and a person with the right skills clears the list in one go.

## How regular updates help results

Current information builds trust. A visitor who finds the right opening hours, the right offer and a recent post is more likely to believe the business is active and to get in touch. Working links and forms mean enquiries actually arrive.

Fresh content helps findability as well. New CMS posts and clear page titles give search engines more accurate pages to show. Quick image compression keeps pages light, which helps visitors on slower connections stay long enough to read. We make these improvements without changing the site's design.

## What a good starter sprint includes

- Text updates on existing pages, matched to your current wording style.
- Image swaps, with files resized and compressed before upload.
- New entries in blogs, work lists or other CMS collections.
- Fixes for broken layouts, overlapping text and misaligned buttons.
- A check of every link and button on the pages we touch.
- A test message through your contact form, to confirm it arrives.
- Review of each edited page on phone and desktop.
- Page titles and descriptions checked on the pages we update.
- A banner or notice for a season or an offer, in larger packages.
- A report of everything changed and a list of ideas for next steps.

## How we work

You send your updates in one place, ideally as a document or a numbered list with attached images. We confirm that it fits the package, ask about anything unclear, then make the changes in your project and review the result across screen sizes.

Basic covers a batch of text and image updates plus the link and form check. Standard allows more updates, adds CMS posts, layout repairs, image compression and title checks. Premium extends this to a larger batch, a new page, more CMS items, a seasonal or offer banner and a priority list for the following quarter, with a period of follow-up fixes.

We publish after you confirm. You can ask us to hold changes until a set date if they relate to a launch or sale.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Collect all updates into a single message.
- Send final text and final images, not drafts.
- Mark any change that is tied to a date.
- Tell us which pages are most important to you.
- Keep a copy of the sprint report for your records.

**Avoid:**
- Sending updates in pieces over several days.
- Mixing new design requests into a content batch.
- Sending images that are far larger than needed, without telling us which to use.
- Leaving outdated pages online because you plan to rewrite them later.
- Assuming a sprint covers monthly care.

## Who this is for

This service suits a small business owner who has no time to update the site, a team with a backlog of changes since the last launch, and a founder who wants to test outside help before committing to a regular plan. It also suits a site that is about to receive traffic and needs a tidy-up first.

## What we need from you

Send your update list with the final wording, images and any page addresses. Invite us as a collaborator on your Framer project, so we work in your own account. We never ask for passwords.

If you want us to write new text, say so when you order, since that is a different kind of job from updating existing content.
